verdict.rationale: The source is publicly readable in the open-webui/open-webui GitHub repository, including its CHANGELOG. Community reports say the license moved from MIT to BSD-3, then to BSD-3 with added custom branding clauses that critics call restrictive and messy, so whether it is truly an open license is questionable. No vendor documentation in the pack states the license terms. missing for 10: first-party statement of the license terms, a clean OSI-approved permissive license without added branding restrictions, stable licensing history.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Effortless Setup: Install seamlessly via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, or helm)
Open WebUI swapped MIT for BSD-3 five months before this change
